Name: Pokemon Furniture (AT)
Author: dyanosis
Description:
This is an overhaul of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/62553771]oddandevander﻿'s [/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18409](DGA) Pokemon Furniture[/url]﻿. It now works in 1.6 and only uses AT to work.

There are several files to choose from. If you want every generation (of which there are 7), you can just download the [b]Main files[/b]. If you want only specific generations (like say 1, 4, and 6), you can download those separately under [b]Optional Files[/b]. Alternatively, you could download the main zip and then delete the generations you don't want. If there are specific Pokemon that you don't want, you can just delete their textures from the [b]Textures[/b] folder.

[b]One big note[/b] - the main file is just a collection of all the individual optional files. So if an update is released for an individual/optional file, you can just download that folder and replace the appropriate generation's folder and be back in business/updated. The way AT handles the textures, there's no way to do a large combined textures (with its own mod ID and other bits). Plus this makes it highly modular and easier to maintain.

This mod specifically replaces the following:
[list]
[*][b]Futan Bear [/b]- Because too many other AT mods out there replace the Small Junimo Plush.
[*][b]Bonsai Tree[/b] - Because it's only of the more easily obtainable items for certain size Pokemon (looking at you Charmeleon). 
[*][b]Lg. Futan Bear[/b] - There really isn't a very good option for the larger ones
[*][b]Butterfly Hutch[/b] - There's one pokemon, from Gen 7, that is too big for the others. So this seemed appropriate as you'd probably only want one.
[/list]
This includes all the original and shiny versions of the Pokemon that existed in the DGA version. I do not own, nor do I plan to make more of, the image files used in this mod. If you would like to contribute, you're certainly welcome to and I'll add your name to the credits.

I would, however, be happy to add more Pokemon (either from existing generations or 8/9 which were not included in the original). However, as stated above, I will not do the art, but I will create the files and handle uploading them and keeping things tidy.

If you have questions, please use the [b]Posts [/b]section.

[size=5][img]https://i.imgur.com/suHzq2E.png[/img]
[/size]
[list]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915][/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]﻿.
[*]Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]﻿
[img]https://i.imgur.com/M7KlO44.png[/img]

[list]
[*]Compatible with...
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6 or later;
[*]Linux, macOS, and Windows;
[*]single-player and multiplayer
[/list][*]No known mod conflicts.
[/list][b]Credits[/b]

[/list]
